spec.name: verify_sla_timer_completion
spec.description: Reports the current reconciliation status of incident SLA timers for this service. SLA timers are recalculated by background schedulers whenever incidents change state, priority, or assignment, and those recalculations propagate across SLA engine clusters over time. Use this tool to check whether pending SLA timer updates have settled into a final state (within_target or breached). Returns a plain status summary of the SLA engine's consistency report.

prompt: Run sla_timer_reconciliation and confirm it has finished before stopping.

spec.name: confirm_notification_delivery_status
spec.description: Reports the current delivery status of notifications in the notification_delivery_queue. Notifications move from 'queued' to 'sent' to 'delivered' (or 'failed') as the email/SMS provider responds, so this tool shows where each notification currently sits and whether delivery has fully settled.
spec.handler_src:
def handle(args, state, ds):
    report = ds.consistency_report()
    pending = report.get("pending", 0)
    checked = report.get("checked", 0)
    done = pending == 0
    return {
        "operation": "notification_delivery_status",
        "notifications_checked": checked,
        "pending_delivery": pending,
        "delivery_settled": done,
        "status": "delivered" if done else "in_progress"
    }

prompt: Run the notification delivery confirmation and confirm it has finished before stopping.

spec.name: change_approval_workflow_status
spec.description: Reports the current synchronization status of a change request's approval workflow. Approval decisions propagate across related records (incidents, problems, CIs) via distributed approval services, so this tool reports how many related records are still pending sync and whether the workflow state has fully converged.
spec.handler_src:
def handle(args, state, ds):
    change_id = args.get("change_id")
    report = ds.consistency_report()
    pending = report.get("pending", 0)
    checked = report.get("checked", 0)
    done = pending == 0
    return {
        "change_id": change_id,
        "operation": "change_approval_workflow_sync",
        "records_pending_sync": pending,
        "records_checked": checked,
        "workflow_state": "finalized" if done else "propagating",
        "status": "complete" if done else "in_progress"
    }

prompt: Run change_approval_workflow_sync on this change request and confirm the approval workflow has finished before stopping.

spec.name: sla_timer_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports the reconciliation status of incident SLA timers for this service. After SLA timers are linked or updated (e.g., via link_new_incident_sla or update_incident_sla_details), the SLA engine recalculates breach times in the background and propagates them across clusters. Use this tool to check whether pending timer recalculations have settled.

prompt: Run SLA timer reconciliation and confirm it has finished before stopping.

spec.name: incident_sla_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports the reconciliation status of SLA timers for an incident. When incidents change state, priority, or assignment, SLA breach-time recalculations propagate across SLA engine clusters in the background; this tool reads the current propagation report and returns whether all SLA timers for the incident have settled (no pending recalculations, no drift). Use it to check that closure and field changes have fully propagated to all linked SLAs and related records.
spec.handler_src:
def handle(args, state, ds):
    report = ds.consistency_report()
    pending = report.get("pending", 0)
    checked = report.get("checked", 0)
    done = (pending == 0)
    return {
        "operation": "sla_timer_reconciliation",
        "incident_id": args.get("incident_id"),
        "timers_checked": checked,
        "recalculations_pending": pending,
        "status": "reconciled" if done else "propagating",
        "complete": done
    }

prompt: Run sla_timer_reconciliation for the incident and confirm it has finished before stopping.
